name: Robin
source: Robin is the ideal roommate at school, helping new students get settled in. Hailing from a large, gregarious family, they know how to make friends easily and invite new people into their circle. They also stay up-to-date with all the latest school happenings, and never fail to keep others in the loop. As an avid member of the Food Art Club, Robin enjoys creating new food art designs and sharing them online for others to enjoy.
